newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger poll to go ahead despite opposition boycott.
newsitem.headline: Niger poll to go ahead despite opposition boycott.

text.p: President Ibrahim Bare Mainassara said on Tuesday Niger's legislative elections would go ahead on November 23 with or without the opposition's participation.
Opposition parties, charging that coup maker Mainassara's victory in a presidential poll in July was illegal, have threatened to boycott the parliamentary elections.
Talks between the government and opposition collapsed on Monday.

"The elections will certainly take place on November 23, with or without the opposition, and they must not think we have to commit harakiri to satisfy them," Mainassara told reporters before leaving on an official visit to Chad.
